correctness.rationale: A complete exact integer acyclic Morse matching on all 1090 independent faces leaves one zero-cell, four three-cells and one four-cell with zero integral attaching boundary. No low-dimensional cells remain; the attaching map is classified by degrees, so this gives free integral homology in ranks 4 and 1. Both primes 101 and 103 give degree-four chain boundary ranks 181 and 58, and exact induced quotient action agrees with the bipartition sign for all 96 enumerated automorphisms. Since integral H4 is Z, the action must be ±1 and reduction recovers it integrally. Signed Lefschetz enumeration recovers H3 characters exhaustively. Integer character inner products verify the one-dimensional edge-sign twist and absolute irreducibility of the 3D remainder. The standalone scripts have been run successfully from their present source paths; checks are exhaustive finite proofs, not general infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The full 96-element automorphism representation of a canonical highly symmetric graph is an intrinsic topological invariant. Prior nonequivariant and cyclic results leave open all additional full-group traces and rational constituent structure. The new exact decomposition identifies a natural three-dimensional absolutely irreducible constituent and establishes vanishing of full-group invariants despite a C8-invariant class, a meaningful structural distinction not explained by simple Betti numbers or arbitrary slices. A finite but natural complete representation classification merits value.
